semantics.actor: Session 保留原 Issue Goal、acceptance、Repo snapshot、訓練資料權利與全需求 inventory
semantics.goal: Preserve actual Issue Goal, acceptance, Repo snapshot, training rights and full original REQ inventory
semantics.measurement: Source Reader compares the complete inspected-unit inventory and original Goal, acceptance, TaskSnapshot and rights references, including preserved UNKNOWN rights; mapping counts alone are insufficient.

semantics.given: Inspected source units、完整原 REQ inventory、原 Issue acceptance 可讀。
semantics.when: 編譯每一 decision-relevant unit，保留原 Goal／negation／unknown。 Proposed behavior；NeoWeaver native 執行尚未發生。
semantics.then: Return the inspected source-unit mapping and named gaps while preserving the original Goal, acceptance, TaskSnapshot and rights status. This is Source Reader/compiler output, not parser execution.
semantics.inputs_outputs: SourceCoverage + PriorInventory + original Goal/acceptance/TaskSnapshot/rights references → MappedUnit[] and NamedGap[] with the same immutable references.
semantics.forbidden: Summary 改了原 acceptance、漏掉 clause、以生成文件授予 merge，均拒絕；資料格式通過不等於語義完整
semantics.negative_case: A generated summary cannot authorize a merge
semantics.unknown_effect: 不能由 Card 判斷外部 effect；原 Owner 回讀前不重送。非外部資料檢查的 effect 為 N/A。
semantics.replay: 固定 bytes、原 acceptance 與相同 scope 才可比較；已提供合法 next 時原樣 reuse。
semantics.oracle: Original source comparison checks both clause coverage and unchanged immutable references; rights UNKNOWN remains visible and only blocks its dependent training.

links.applicability: Inspected-unit mapping and preservation of immutable source references. Actual source truth and permitted training rights remain original Source/rights responsibilities.
links.counterfactual: If the original required outcome changes, review this bounded output contract: SourceCoverage + PriorInventory + original Goal/acceptance/TaskSnapshot/rights references → MappedUnit[] and NamedGap[] with the same immutable references. It supports only the stated clause, not unobserved parent results.

links.applicability: The V checks this same Consumer result: Return the inspected source-unit mapping and named gaps while preserving the original Goal, acceptance, TaskSnapshot and rights status. This is Source Reader/compiler output, not parser execution.
links.counterfactual: Without the original V method/input distinction, this result is not verified: Source Reader compares full inspected-unit coverage and unchanged Goal, acceptance, TaskSnapshot and rights status. Missing downstream evidence must not change the local proof scope.

cards.title: Trainability boundary
evidence_topics: Original ten logical REQ rows and all handoff sections

semantics.given: Owner-issued TaskSnapshot, FailureScope, mutation allowlist and immutable acceptance references are available; the single-surface PatchProposal has expected old source references.
semantics.when: The boundary parser reads raw JSON and the Patch Validator compares the candidate targets and expected source references with those fixed inputs.
semantics.then: Return ParsedProposal for a well-formed, current, allowed single-surface candidate, or DiagnosticRefusal naming the failed condition. Neither result starts replay, training or provider effects.
semantics.inputs_outputs: Raw PatchProposal JSON + TaskSnapshot + FailureScope + fixed allowlist and acceptance references → ParsedProposal or DiagnosticRefusal. The parser cannot replace those references or certify their source truth.
semantics.forbidden: Do not accept duplicate keys, stale expected source, targets outside the allowlist, protected oracle/acceptance edits, credentials or effect fields; do not execute a proposal.
semantics.negative_case: Keep the otherwise valid proposal fixed and independently introduce a duplicate key, stale expected source, protected target or extra effect field; each must produce a diagnostic refusal and no replay/write.
semantics.unknown_effect: The parser produces no external effects. Missing required Owner input yields DiagnosticRefusal; unknown effects from an earlier operation require its original Owner readback and are not repaired by replaying a write.
semantics.replay: Re-reading identical raw proposal and fixed boundary inputs must reproduce the same parse/refusal decision. This is parser determinism, not TaskSnapshot replay.
semantics.oracle: Original fixed parser controls compare the returned variant, diagnostic condition and unchanged immutable references; execution/reward/native outcomes remain NOT_RUN.
semantics.original_owner: Original NeoWeaver parser/Patch Validator; Source Reader and authorization Producers retain their own truth and effect boundaries.

links.applicability: Raw parsing and static fixed-target/source/acceptance checks only. TaskSnapshot replay and complete training readiness remain parent obligations.
links.counterfactual: If the original required outcome changes, review this bounded output contract: Raw PatchProposal JSON + TaskSnapshot + FailureScope + fixed allowlist and acceptance references → ParsedProposal or DiagnosticRefusal. The parser cannot replace those references or certify their source truth. It supports only the stated clause, not unobserved parent results.

links.applicability: The V checks this same Consumer result: Return ParsedProposal for a well-formed, current, allowed single-surface candidate, or DiagnosticRefusal naming the failed condition. Neither result starts replay, training or provider effects.
links.counterfactual: Without the original V method/input distinction, this result is not verified: Original parser controls compare ParsedProposal/DiagnosticRefusal, named condition and unchanged fixed references; TaskSnapshot replay is not part of this oracle. Missing downstream evidence must not change the local proof scope.

links.applicability: Parser checks protected targets and fixed acceptance references before any execution.
links.counterfactual: A changed immutable-oracle rule changes which parsed targets must refuse.

links.applicability: This parser contract returns data and cannot authorize effects.
links.counterfactual: If the effect boundary changes, the parser output/forbidden-effect controls need original review.

links.applicability: Only the protected-acceptance restriction applies here, not reward/update gates.
links.counterfactual: If protected acceptance may be mutated, allowed-target parser controls no longer protect the parent acceptance.

cards.title: Two policies
evidence_topics: Original ten logical REQ rows and all handoff sections

semantics.actor: Proposer πθ 學 Harness；open Solver πφ 僅在有效自身 token lineage 下更新；Codex 保持 frozen
semantics.goal: Proposer πθ modifies Harness; optional open Solver πφ is trained only with valid own token provenance; Codex φC stays frozen
semantics.measurement: Compare each sample with the selected policy/action/generation/reward lineage, then separately read the update Owner result for selected-policy-only mutation and fixed counterpart; Codex remains frozen.
semantics.persistence: 保留原十項 parent REQ、原 Goal 與 acceptance；失敗後不重設 effort horizon。
semantics.stop_escalation: 未知 effect 先原 Owner readback；缺此需求必要資料只停止其依賴操作。
semantics.acceptance: Only the selected policy may update from its eligible data; actor/action/reward lineage is bound to the same observation, the counterpart stays fixed for the selected comparison, and Codex weights are not updated.
semantics.non_case: 把 Codex transcript 算成 πθ 的 policy-gradient tokens、補造 logprob／tokens／weights 皆拒絕；缺 Solver provenance 不影響獨立 Proposer source preparation

semantics.given: 原 RolloutObservation 有 actor/policy/action/token provenance，reward 可連至同次 observation。

semantics.negative_case: Codex transcript cannot be treated as Proposer policy-gradient tokens
semantics.unknown_effect: 不能由 Card 判斷外部 effect；原 Owner 回讀前不重送。非外部資料檢查的 effect 為 N/A。

semantics.oracle: Eligibility compares the original policy/action/generation/reward/split references. The update Owner independently checks the selected-policy and frozen-counterpart boundary.

links.applicability: Selected-policy sample lineage/eligibility only. Actual policy update and frozen-counterpart observations remain Trainer responsibilities.
links.counterfactual: If the original required outcome changes, review this bounded output contract: ActorRollout + RewardObservation → EligibleTrainingSample 或 IneligibleReason；open Solver 需要自身 tokens。 It supports only the stated clause, not unobserved parent results.

links.applicability: The V checks this same Consumer result: Return EligibleTrainingSample or IneligibleReason for the selected policy. This result does not itself prove an update or frozen counterpart; those require the Trainer readback.

Missing downstream evidence must not change the local proof scope.

links.counterfactual: If foreign tokens are treated as own generation, the sample-eligibility oracle changes.

cards.title: Causal attribution boundary
evidence_topics: Original ten logical REQ rows and all handoff sections

semantics.given: A/B/C/D 觀察或明示缺失，task/environment/budget/population 匹配。
semantics.when: 原 evaluator 比較固定 counterpart 並區分 component 與 interaction。 Proposed behavior；NeoWeaver native 執行尚未發生。
semantics.then: Report only identifiable components from matched observed arms: A/B supports HarnessDifference; A/C supports SolverDifference; all four support Interaction. Missing components remain NOT_RUN; unmatched comparisons are INCONCLUSIVE.
semantics.inputs_outputs: MatchedArms with original population/resource/oracle references → observed component differences with per-component availability. A/D can report a joint total difference, without component attribution; never synthesize missing arms.
semantics.forbidden: 只看 D 或單次改善便宣稱成功、或不匹配預算／task population，均 INCONCLUSIVE；不將 interaction 當單一政策效果
semantics.negative_case: Improvement in D alone cannot identify cause
semantics.unknown_effect: 不能由 Card 判斷外部 effect；原 Owner 回讀前不重送。非外部資料檢查的 effect 為 N/A。
semantics.replay: 固定 bytes、原 acceptance 與相同 scope 才可比較；已提供合法 next 時原樣 reuse。
semantics.oracle: Original evaluator checks B−A, C−A and D−B−C+A only when their matched input arms exist; positive paired repeatability and hard gates are separate whole-Goal requirements.

links.applicability: Report each identifiable comparison from its available matched arms. Held-out frozen transfer and repeatable positive whole-Goal measurement remain separate.
links.counterfactual: If the original required outcome changes, review this bounded output contract: MatchedArms with original population/resource/oracle references → observed component differences with per-component availability. A/D can report a joint total difference, without component attribution; never synthesize missing arms. It supports only the stated clause, not unobserved parent results.

links.applicability: The V checks this same Consumer result: Report only identifiable components from matched observed arms: A/B supports HarnessDifference; A/C supports SolverDifference; all four support Interaction. Missing components remain NOT_RUN; unmatched comparisons are INCONCLUSIVE.
links.counterfactual: Without the original V method/input distinction, this result is not verified: Original paired evaluator checks matched input availability and component formulas, with whole-Goal hard gates/repeatability measured separately. Missing downstream evidence must not change the local proof scope.

links.target_topic: Harness only versus joint policy update
links.applicability: Arm availability determines which comparison is supported.
links.counterfactual: If counterpart-freezing or matched conditions change, component comparisons are no longer the same experiment.

links.target_topic: Joint result does not identify a component effect
links.applicability: Component attribution requires its identifiable matched arms.
links.counterfactual: With missing B/C, the interaction/components cannot be obtained from the joint total.
